dk-copenhagen-flash-superficial-tumors.identity: Canine FLASH vs conventional radiotherapy, 1–4 treatments up to four weeks.
dk-copenhagen-flash-superficial-tumors.recruitment_sites: Copenhagen University Hospital patient list actively invites this tumor group, with treatment travel to Sweden in the Lund collaboration; Oxford is a research collaborator, not an enrollment site.
dk-copenhagen-flash-superficial-tumors.eligibility: Tumor of skin, subcutis or oral cavity, untreated or incompletely removed, only if expected benefit; repeated anesthesia and no serious concurrent illness; rabies vaccination and EU pet passport for Sweden.
dk-copenhagen-flash-superficial-tumors.funding: Project pays treatment and follow-up visits, owner pays for the EU pet passport; no other coverage promised.
dk-copenhagen-flash-superficial-tumors.deadline: Published project period 2020–2027 only; no specific month/day. Do not infer a calendar-day cutoff.

ill-osa-il12-rt-current.identity: Illinois intratumoral JEN-101 after affected-limb radiation, followed by amputation at four weeks; use the canonical successor, not the older generic alias.
ill-osa-il12-rt-current.recruitment_sites: October protocol is the exact current funded listing on University of Illinois roster; treatment and mandatory amputation at Urbana.
ill-osa-il12-rt-current.eligibility: Nonmetastatic appendicular OSA confirmed by cytology/histology with ALP; no earlier chemotherapy, radiotherapy, immunotherapy/checkpoint treatment, steroids or listed immune modulators; sufficient organ function for sedation.
ill-osa-il12-rt-current.funding: Owner screening, follow-up exam/bloodwork, unrelated care, remaining amputation; study RT/JEN-101, associated treatment visits, follow-up abdominal ultrasound and chest radiographs, up to $2,500 on-site amputation credit.
ill-osa-il12-rt-current.deadline: No cutoff in current individual PDF or master.

ill-osa-z007-current.identity: Illinois eight weekly IV Z-007 doses targeting measurable pulmonary metastases of canine osteosarcoma; do not merge with Tufts or historical Illinois alias.
ill-osa-z007-current.recruitment_sites: Current Illinois clinical trials roster links the exact October protocol at Urbana.
ill-osa-z007-current.eligibility: Active or historic OSA (any primary site), lung nodule >=5 mm by CT, controlled pain if no amputation, expected survival at least 9 weeks, >=7 days since RT and >=21 days since chemo/immunotherapy. Exclude immunosuppression, pleural effusion, hypoxia or respiratory distress.
ill-osa-z007-current.funding: Owner pays screening and unrelated care. After eligibility the study covers exams, bloodwork, Z-007 and CT.
ill-osa-z007-current.deadline: No cutoff in current individual PDF or master.
